d: Bernie realizes he may have been too truthful when telling Jordan about his father; he amends the truth to make Jordan think well of his father.
Bernie volunteers as a teacher's helper to assess the teaching methods used at Bryana's school; Wanda is at wits' end trying to reason with Vanessa and Jordan.
The family goes to San Diego for a relaxing vacation; Bernie, unable to relax, goes to Las Vegas for some gambling and debauchery.
A motorcycle accident changes Bernie's perspective about protecting the kids; Jordan is caught trying to sell Bernie's girlie magazines to other boys at school.
Neighbor Carl Reiner (guest starring as himself) plays the ultimate practical joke on Bernie. Ashton Kutcher guest stars as himself.
Dr. Phil McGraw counsels Bernie on how to deal with Wanda, who feels left out after Bernie and the guys draft a woman (Mo'Nique) into their group.
Bernie stops by the Playboy Mansion to get advice from Hugh Hefner on how to talk to Jordan about sex.
"American Idol" judges Paula Abdul and Randy Jackson critique Bernie's commercial.
Bernie and Wanda seek a child therapist's help in figuring out why Bryana has become a bully; Wanda winds up caring for a guinea pig Bernie bought for Bryana.
On Bernie's 40th birthday, he is electrically shocked by an old lady and forced to be a clown at a children's party.
Bernie has to put his foot down after Mr. Diggs, Vanessa's teacher, persuades her to become a vegetarian.
Bernie resorts to spying when he decides Vanessa is being secretive about her activities, but his security cameras pick up more than he bargained for.

Four Atlanta teenagers, whose lives revolve around hip-hop and rollerskating, face life-changing challenges on and off the rink.

Omar finally attends church and gives a powerful testimony that shocks everyone; Keith vulnerably professes his feelings for Jackee through poetry; Jarvis learns some truths that change everything he thought he knew about his family history.

Omar learns some shocking information about Bianca; Greg gets out-hustled by an unwanted house guest; Keith notices his neighborhood is changing and blames his local councilman; Jarvis visits the man who claims to be his father.
Omar, Greg, Keith and Jarvis attend the Annual Quintessential Gentleman's mixer; Keith ruins the vibe when he confronts his local councilman over his rising rent.
Omar witnesses Naomi out with another man; Greg sets a bad first impression when he meets with Chef Williams; Keith meets Jackee's parents for the first time.
Greg makes himself a little too comfortable during date night at Jarvis' house; Jarvis confronts his parents about his past; Omar's late-night meeting with Bianca comes to an unexpected end.
Keith and Booker try to come to an understanding; Omar reconnects with Naomi; Greg enlists the fellas' help on a plan to get Reggie out of his house for good; musical artist Patrick Paige performs.

Omar's first attempt at yoga doesn't go so well; Keith shows Jackee the contents of her father's developed photos; Jarvis gets his petty revenge on Antoinette while Omar, Greg and Keith attend Caleb's football game.
Jarvis surprises the fellas with a token of appreciation for their friendship; Love is in the air as Booker and Sherrie go on a date while Keith takes his disapproval of their relationship too far.

Jarvis hangs out with his new family and realizes how much they don't have in common; Keith challenges Alan Garrett at the city council meeting while Omar's relationship with Eugene is tested after an encounter with a patron turns violent.

Greg impresses Chef Williams with his newfound passion for the culinary arts; Omar visits Naomi at her job unannounced; Keith receives an unexpected letter while Jarvis gets caught in the middle of a family confrontation.

Greg mentors a teenager through Big Brothers Big Sisters of America while Jarvis and Freddie Sr. play a card game; the group organizes an intervention for Omar, and Samoht performs as the musical guest.
Omar, Greg, Keith and Jarvis Johnson have a guys' night out that doesn't go exactly as planned; they run into popular radio host Eugene Johnson.
